description: TypeScript SDK for Twitter search, followers, webhooks, MCP & X automation. Not affiliated with X Corp.
rules: Use README.md first for install, API key setup, TypeScript and JavaScript examples, webhooks, and common workflows.
Use https://docs.xquik.com/mcp/overview for current MCP authentication and client compatibility. MCP access is separate from this REST SDK.
Use api.md for the resource map, method names, request parameters, response types, and endpoint coverage.
Use package.json and the npm package x-twitter-scraper for package metadata, exports, and supported runtimes.
Prefer X_TWITTER_SCRAPER_API_KEY environment configuration; never put API keys in source files or examples.
For TypeScript code, import the default XTwitterScraper client and use the XTwitterScraper namespace types for request and response shapes.
Follow the code style of the files around a change, and match feature claims to the Xquik OpenAPI spec and docs.
